Subject: Portal PO issuer mapping and MSA - next steps

Hi Irene —

Thanks for taking this. We’re in the middle of our procurement intake and legal review for the MSA + Order Form. A couple of items blocking our Ariba/Coupa provisioning:

- We need confirmation on which PO-issuer_id value you will populate from your side (we have fields PO_Issuer_ID and PO_Payer_ID in our Ariba mapping).
- Our finance team requires the signatory matrix: who is authorized to sign on behalf of Redwood (name, title, signing limits).
- We received your redline from Legal but we need to know whether you accept delegated signers (e.g., authorised procurement delegates) or require an original counter-signature for the order form.

Can you confirm the mapping and preferred signer approach? Hoping to get portal access provisioned this week so we can start sending test POs.

Thanks,
Susan

From: irene_choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Patel <susan.patel@northridgehealth.org>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Portal PO issuer mapping and MSA - next steps

Hi Susan —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps from our side:

1) PO issuer mapping: we typically populate PO_Issuer_ID with our legal entity code "RWINF-US-01" and include an additional PO_Payer_ID field when customers require invoice-to differencing. If your flow requires a different canonical value, attach a sample CSV and we’ll map to it.

2) Signatory matrix: attaching our redline (Northridge_MSA_redline_v3.pdf) and an orderform template. The current default signatory for MSA-level obligations is Markus Klein (SVP Legal). On order forms, delegated procurement signers (title: VP/Director of Procurement or equivalent) are acceptable within pre-agreed limits — we can document those limits in an amendment.

3) Delegated signature: we can accept delegated signers if we capture the signer name, title, business email, and a delegation attestation (signed PDF or DocuSign flow). If Northridge prefers original countersignature on the MSA, flag and we’ll route to Markus for the wet signature/DocuSign envelope.

Next actions:
- Susan: confirm the canonical PO_Issuer_ID you expect (or send sample mapping).
- Kimberly: can your team confirm whether the Ariba connector will accept delegated-signature attestation as a document attachment? If not, we’ll prepare a DocuSign envelope.
- Markus: pinging you for legal confirmation on delegated-signature limits.

I’ve attached the redline + order form. I’ll keep this thread in my mailbox and escalate as needed.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
irene@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Northridge_MSA_redline_v3.pdf]

From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: irene_choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Susan Patel <susan.patel@northridgehealth.org>, markus_klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Dec 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Portal PO issuer mapping and MSA - next steps

Thanks Irene / Susan —

Operational notes from Redwood Ops / Connector team:
- Ariba field mapping we support today: PO_NUMBER, PO_LINE_NUMBER, PO_Issuer_ID, PO_Payer_ID, PO_ACK_EXPECTED (Y/N), SFTP_DELIVERY_PATH.
- For PO_Issuer_ID we can accept either the entity code (RWINF-US-01) or a numeric vendor id, but we need a one-to-one mapping file (CSV) to seed into the connector. I’ve attached po_issuer_mapping_sample.csv for your reference.
- Our connector accepts PDF attachments on the PO payload (up to 5MB). That will work for a delegation attestation. If Northridge needs signed envelopes (DocuSign), provide the envelope ID and we’ll verify signature authenticity.

Questions for Northridge:
- Confirm whether the PO_ACK_EXPECTED should be Y or N for your test lane (we’ll default to Y).
- Do you require PO line-level GL code on the PO or can you accept a single consolidated GL on invoice?

Timeline: once mapping file is received we can enable a test endpoint within 48 hours.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Manager, Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: po_issuer_mapping_sample.csv]

Thanks Kim / Irene —

Quick clarifications from our onboarding team:
- We will provide the PO_Issuer_ID as numeric vendor id unless you need the legal code — either works as long as it’s consistent. We’ll send the CSV by EOD.
- Delegate signatures: Northridge prefers an attestation PDF attached to the vendor record and will only require a DocuSign on the MSA if the contract value > $250k. That approach should be fine; please confirm you’ll accept the attestation PDF as proof of delegation.

Also, timeline note: we can provision portal access (Ariba supplier) once mapping + attestation are in place — target start for test POs: next Wednesday (22 Dec).

Regards,

On delegated signatures: Northridge proposes accepting a delegation attestation PDF for order forms and requiring DocuSign only for contracts > $250k. I’m proposing Redwood accepts the attestation for portal onboarding and we document the threshold in a short amendment to the MSA / Order Form.

Markus — can you confirm: 1) ok to accept the attestation PDF as sufficient for portal onboarding (we’ll keep the MSA countersign process for > $250k), and 2) sign-off language for an amendment that explicitly allows delegated procurement signers up to $250k (subject to attestation)? If that’s a yes, please approve and I’ll send the amendment (one-paragraph) to Northridge and push the DocuSign envelope for the MSA redline if needed.

Kim — once Markus confirms, I’ll drop the mapping CSV into our internal connector queue and ask Ops to open a test endpoint. Rajiv — please route the CSV + attestation to kimberly@redwoodinference.com.

Thanks —
